study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multiscale heterogeneity of functional connectivity in autism

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Pooled scans from LEAP, ABIDE-I, and ABIDE-II.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: “We pooled scans from three large datasets: the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) ... and the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchanges I and II, or ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II”

answer.LEAP: Pooled into the overall sample for normative modeling; NT used to train normative model and autistic sample used to test deviations.

answer.ABIDE-I: Pooled into the overall sample for normative modeling; NT used to train normative model and autistic sample used to test deviations.

answer.ABIDE-II: Pooled into the overall sample for normative modeling; NT used to train normative model and autistic sample used to test deviations.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All three datasets were pooled; normative model trained on neurotypical controls and tested on autistic individuals; 10-fold cross-validation performed within controls.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: “We pooled scans from three large datasets: the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) ... and the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchanges I and II, or ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II” ... “The normative model was trained on the group of neurotypical individuals ... and was then tested on the FC maps of the autistic individual's group ... We quantified the extent of FC deviations in the control group using 10-fold crossvalidation.”
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Ilioska2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Participants; Ilioska2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative modeling

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative model trained on neurotypical controls; overall N=1028. Train-phase counts not explicitly reported (10-fold CV mentioned).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: “The final sample included 796 autistic individuals ... and 1028 neuro-typical (NT) individuals ...” “The normative model was trained on the group of neurotypical individuals ... We quantified the extent of FC deviations in the control group using 10-fold crossvalidation.”
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Ilioska2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Participants; Ilioska2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative modeling
